title: MultiModel Dev OS Registry Manifest Schema
description: JSON schema for the registry manifest file that accompanies remote catalog indexes, providing provenance metadata and integrity checksums

registry_name.description: Unique name identifier of the registry.

publisher.description: Name of the person or organization that published this registry.

version.description: Semantic version of the registry catalog.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manifest was generated.

catalog_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the catalog.yaml file, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

files_hashes.description: Map of filename to SHA256 hash string for each file in the registry.

minimum_mmdo_version.description: Minimum MultiModel Dev OS version required to use this registry.

safety_policy_version.description: Version of the safety policy specification this registry conforms to.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature block of the manifest.

signatures.description: List of cryptographic signature blocks of the manifest.
